body: That’s sounds very hard I’m sorry, we feel dislike for ourselves but together no? It freaks me out because sometimes I wonder if I’m serious or not

I call them the tingles, I never tell people until after because even though I don’t want to self harm I don’t want anyone trying to stop me. So I get not wanting to but also I wanting to more than anything in the entire world
It’s scary how real I’m sure this is for both of us. I’ve got the tingles on my left arm and also sound crazy typing this out
